classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design up to 2 binder candidates against a user-supplied target PDB using two parallel BindCraft trajectory shards, evaluate per-sequence quality with sequence_analysis, aggregate and rank candidates with rank_designs, and surface the top-ranked result.
assumptions: params.target_pdb must be supplied at runtime; no PDB path or PDB ID was included in the request.
No hotspot residues were specified; BindCraft will select the binding interface autonomously — interface quality may be suboptimal without hotspot guidance.
binder_length=60 (default) and num_recycles=1 are the cheapest valid BindCraft settings and are consistent with the compact-workflow request.
filter_mode=permissive is used to maximise yield when only 1 design per shard is requested.
Two trajectory shards (seeds 1 and 2, num_designs=1 each) run at max_parallel=2 matching the tool default_max_parallel.
BindCraft design objects expose a 'sequence' string field that sequence_analysis can consume via ${item.sequence}.
sequence_analysis is run once per design so per-sequence metrics and liabilities are individually available to rank_designs.
rank_designs top_k=2 matches the at-most-two-candidate request.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target .pdb structure file — required by bindcraft and not provided in the request
